description: Return the mermaid syntax reference: every supported diagram family with a short summary and a working example, or — narrowed to one family — a compact syntax primer. Call this before writing mermaid source.

family.description: Only return this diagram family (`flowchart`, `sequenceDiagram`, …; aliases like `graph`, `sequence` or `state` are accepted). Omit for the one-line overview of every family.

example.description: A minimal, valid mermaid example of this family.

family.description: Canonical family name (`flowchart`, `sequenceDiagram`, …) — the same string `canvas::validate` reports and `canvas::create` stores.

summary.description: One-line description of what this family is for.

families.description: The reference entries — every family for the overview, exactly one when the request named a family.

syntax.description: The reference as readable text: one line per family for the overview, or the named family's syntax primer with its example.
